title: A/B Test Ship Decision with SRM Guard
hints: Build norm_cdf from math.erf, then invert it by bisection exactly as the statement says. Every quantile (the CI multiplier and both sample-size quantiles) comes from that one function.
The z-test uses the pooled rate for its standard error (under the null both arms share one rate). The confidence interval uses the unpooled standard error.
Two-sided means z_(1 - alpha/2) and a p-value of erfc(|z| / sqrt(2)), which equals 2 * (1 - Phi(|z|)) without the cancellation.
Check the decision rules in order. A sample ratio mismatch invalidates everything, and a significant harm rolls back even before the test is fully powered.
